description: A distributed attack in which many sources send a flood of ICMP packets, typically echo requests (pings), to a target. The target has to process and often answer each one, which consumes bandwidth and CPU. On the network it appears as an abnormally high rate of ICMP traffic reaching one destination from many sources.
